I kept waiting for the right moment to say things — the bottle, the crackers, the conversation I knew we needed to have — and every time I told myself I was being strategic or careful, when really I was just buying myself a little more time before having to say something uncomfortable. The other thing I'd change is I'd ask more questions and make fewer assumptions.
